knowledge:
- key_parameters: d=The input data matrix (features as rows, items as columns) or a pre-computed dist object ;; maxK=The maximum number of clusters to evaluate (e.g., 6) ;; reps=The number of subsampling repetitions (e.g., 50 or 1000) ;; pItem=The proportion of items (columns) to sample in each iteration (e.g., 0.8) ;; pFeature=The proportion of features (rows) to sample in each iteration (e.g., 1.0) ;; title=Character string specifying the output directory path where graphical and tabular results are saved ;; clusterAlg=The clustering algorithm to use, such as "hc" (hierarchical), "pam" (partitioning around medoids), "km" (kmeans), or a custom function ;; distance=The distance metric to use, such as "pearson", "spearman", "euclidean", "binary", "maximum", "canberra", "minkowski", or a custom function ;; seed=A random number seed to ensure reproducibility ;; plot=The output plot format, such as "png", "pdf", "pngBMP", or NULL ;; writeTable=Boolean indicating whether to write consensus matrices, ICL, and logs to CSV files
- alternatives: Web-based Consensus Clustering (Monti et al., 2003) ;; Custom clustering algorithms can be supplied as a hook function (e.g., using diana from the cluster package)
- when_to_use: When performing unsupervised class discovery on high-dimensional genomic datasets (e.g., microarray or RNA-seq expression profiles) to identify stable molecular subtypes and determine the optimal number of clusters (k)
- pitfalls: Using too few repetitions (reps=50 is fine for testing, but reps=1000 is recommended for actual analyses) ;; High computational cost on large datasets when recalculating distance matrices (if feature resampling is not needed, i.e., pFeature=1, passing a pre-computed distance matrix as 'd' is much faster) ;; Plotting failures on large datasets (use plot="pngBMP" to avoid plotting the consensus matrix dendrogram and use bitmap plotting instead of standard png)

workflows.name: standard_consensus_clustering
workflows.intent: Perform consensus clustering on a gene expression matrix to identify stable sample clusters and calculate cluster/item consensus.
input: expression_matrix.csv (a numeric matrix of gene expression values where columns represent samples and rows represent genes)
workflows.stages: 1. Filter features by variability using median absolute deviation (mad) ;; 2. Median-center the features using sweep ;; 3. Run consensus clustering using ConsensusClusterPlus ;; 4. Calculate cluster and item consensus using calcICL
workflows.code:
library(ALL)
data(ALL)
d=exprs(ALL)
mads=apply(d,1,mad)
d=d[rev(order(mads))[1:5000],]
d = sweep(d,1, apply(d,1,median,na.rm=T))
library(ConsensusClusterPlus)
title=tempdir()
results = ConsensusClusterPlus(d,maxK=6,reps=50,pItem=0.8,pFeature=1,title=title,clusterAlg="hc",distance="pearson",seed=1262118388.71279,plot="png")
icl = calcICL(results,title=title,plot="png")

workflows.name: custom_distance_consensus_clustering
workflows.intent: Perform consensus clustering using a pre-computed custom distance matrix to reduce computation time on large datasets.
input: expression_matrix.csv (a numeric matrix of gene expression values where columns represent samples and rows represent genes)
workflows.stages: 1. Compute a custom distance matrix from the expression data ;; 2. Run consensus clustering using ConsensusClusterPlus with the pre-computed distance matrix
